_note: Rates were read from the live page on as_of, not carried over from memory or another repo. A stale rate produces a confidently wrong cost figure, which is worse than no figure - so `as_of` and `source` are printed in the report's run metadata for date-checking. Token counts are measured independently of price and are unaffected if a rate here is wrong.
_matching: Model names are matched EXACTLY against the string the callback reports, which is the dated snapshot id (e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18'). Aliases are listed explicitly rather than prefix-matched: prefix-matching 'gpt-5' would happily price 'gpt-5-mini' at 'gpt-5' rates, a 5x error in the wrong direction.

@cf/baai/bge-m3.note: Cloudflare Workers AI bills per neuron, not per token, so a token-derived dollar figure would be category-wrong - a number that looks authoritative and measures nothing. Excluded from every rolled-up dollar total; never raises UnpricedModelError. Pricing this correctly means adding neuron accounting, not inventing a per-token rate. Measured 2026-08-18: the Cloudflare embedding response carries no `usage` field at all (keys: data, model, object), so there is no token count to report either - only call counts.
